originalSourceText:
Q.10  What is a key architectural difference in YOLOv8 compared to earlier YOLO versions
         (like YOLOv5)?

       (A) YOLOv8 uses an anchor-based detection head, while earlier versions were anchor-
       free

       (B) YOLOv8 uses an anchor-free detection head, reducing the need for predefined
      anchor boxes

       (C) YOLOv8 removes convolutional layers entirely and uses only fully connected layers

       (D) YOLOv8 does not support object detection and is used only for image classification

      Explanation:

      Refer Slide 24 of Lecture 35: Object Detection Using YOLOv8
